Write the Project's AI Instructions

Source: R/rProject-ai.R
AI.Rd

Writes the instruction files that AI tools read in this project, on top of the global instructions installed by AIGlobal().

Usage

AI(path, type = NULL, sif = NULL)

Arguments

path

Character string. Project path.

type

Character vector. Project types: any of "package", "manuscript", "simulation", "library", and "talk".

sif

Character string. File name of the Apptainer image.

Value

Returns the paths of the files that were written, invisibly.

Details

  • .setup/ai/project.md: project facts that the user maintains. Created once and never overwritten.

  • AGENTS.md (Codex, Copilot CLI, Claude through CLAUDE.md), CLAUDE.md (Claude Code), and .github/copilot-instructions.md (Copilot in the IDE): generated, and rewritten when they change.

All of them are private (gitignored and excluded from the package build).

The project type and the image come from type and sif, else from an ai list in .setup/scripts/project.R (e.g., ai <- list(type = c("manuscript", "simulation"), sif = "x.sif")), else they are detected: "simulation" if .sim exists, "manuscript" if a *-manuscript*.Rtex exists or the name starts with man, "library" for lib-*, "talk" for talks*, otherwise "package"; the image defaults to docs.sif.
